job_authorizations_operation_check.name: job_authorizations_operation_check
job_authorizations_operation_check.value:
("app_private"."job_authorizations"."operation" = 'extract_receipt' and "app_private"."job_authorizations"."resource_kind" = 'receipt') or
    ("app_private"."job_authorizations"."operation" = 'extract_recipe' and "app_private"."job_authorizations"."resource_kind" = 'recipe') or
    ("app_private"."job_authorizations"."operation" = 'extract_order' and "app_private"."job_authorizations"."resource_kind" = 'order') or
    ("app_private"."job_authorizations"."operation" = 'extract_product' and "app_private"."job_authorizations"."resource_kind" = 'upload' and "app_private"."job_authorizations"."resource_id" = "app_private"."job_authorizations"."upload_id")

mail_outbox_pending_payload_check.name: mail_outbox_pending_payload_check
mail_outbox_pending_payload_check.value: "auth_private"."mail_outbox"."sent_at" is not null or "auth_private"."mail_outbox"."discarded_at" is not null or "auth_private"."mail_outbox"."encrypted_payload" is not null

oauth_transactions_initiator_check.name: oauth_transactions_initiator_check
oauth_transactions_initiator_check.value: ("auth_private"."oauth_transactions"."purpose" = 'login' and "auth_private"."oauth_transactions"."initiating_user_id" is null and "auth_private"."oauth_transactions"."initiating_session_id" is null and "auth_private"."oauth_transactions"."expected_security_version" is null) or ("auth_private"."oauth_transactions"."purpose" <> 'login' and "auth_private"."oauth_transactions"."initiating_user_id" is not null and "auth_private"."oauth_transactions"."initiating_session_id" is not null and "auth_private"."oauth_transactions"."expected_security_version" is not null and "auth_private"."oauth_transactions"."expected_security_version" >= 1)
